title: Restriction naturality of canonical section comparisons
statement: Let T → S → R be morphisms h,f with composite k, G a sheaf of sets on the small etale site of R, and v : V → W a morphism of etale objects over R. The canonical section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] for (h,f,k) commutes with restriction along the base changes of v: comparison on W followed by restriction along k*v equals restriction along f*v followed by comparison on V. No limit, qcqs or affine hypothesis is required.

source.place: Sites Tags 03CB and 03CC; naturality calculation for the definition of the section comparison

proof.text: Package the adjunction unit, composition comparison, equality transport, and opposite of the pullback-pasting transformation as four whiskered natural transformations. Their composite has components exactly etaleSetSectionComparison. Apply naturality of the composite to v.op and take the symmetric equality.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSetSectionComparison_naturality
    {R S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ R) (k : T ⟶ R) (hk : h ≫ f = k)
    (G : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    {V W : R.Etale} (v : V ⟶ W) :
    etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk G W ≫
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj G).obj.map
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ k).map v).op =
      ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj G).obj.map
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).map v).op ≫
        etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk G V
